option_b: If these forests are opened up for mining purposes the remaining rivers and streams will dry up.
option_c: The state of Jharkhand faces water scarcity every summer.

explanation: CADB Sentence C will be the starting line as it contains the main idea of the parajumble i.e. water scarcity in Jharkhand. However, Sentence A states that Saranda forests, in Singhbhum, are a huge catchment for rivers and streams in this state. So, A will follow C. Further, Sentence D states that these forests are India's largest contiguous Sal forests and the current plan says mining should not be allowed in the dense forest & Sentence B states that if these forests are opened up for mining purposes the remaining rivers and streams will dry up. So, B will follow D. Going through the options, option d has the correct sequence.
